newsitems.title: Demo De-activation
newsitems.author: rick
newsitems.contents: Demo Update I will be de-activating the Settler's Domain demo on August 14! That will be 1 week before the full release. If you want to try the demo, now's your time!! :D

newsitems.title: Release Date Update!
newsitems.author: rick
newsitems.contents: Settler's Domain is now releasing on August 21! I realized that the 25th is opening night for gamescom, so it's probably not the best day to release. But hey, now you get the game 4 days earlier!! Woohoo!

newsitems.title: Release Date Announcement!
newsitems.author: rick
newsitems.contents: After almost two years of development, Settler's Domain finally has a release date! On August 25, 2026, I'll be excited to share it with everyone!Check out the release date trailer:Mark your calendars! It'll be the best Tuesday you've had in a while.-rick

newsitems.title: Settler's Domain Closed Beta!!!
newsitems.author: rick
newsitems.contents: BIG NEWS!! I am starting to give out keys for the closed beta of Settler's Domain! The beta has all the intended content that the full release will have, but it's still very rough around the edges (it needs balancing, UX improvements, finished game sprites, bug fixes, etc). If you want to playtest the beta, join the Settler's Domain Discord server and request a key: http://discord.gg/qFDtxMm57F

newsitems.title: Update - Demo Build v0.3 and Working Toward Full Release
newsitems.author: rick
newsitems.contents: Demo build v0.3 is live!It's been a while! Almost a year since I've updated the demo, and over a year since the original demo release. Just crazy. Thanks all for your patience as it's just me working on this thing, and I only have so much time!That being said, I've been pouring hours into Settler's Domain in the last couple months. There are a ton of changes since the last build, I certainly cannot highlight them all here. Check out the updated trailer and screenshots to see some of them! Or, give the demo another shot (you'll need to start a new world anyway, v0.2 saves are not compatible with v0.3). Below you'll find a rough list of big additions/changes.BIG Changes: Other SettlementsYou can now discover other settlements!!!Added Diplomacy menu with multiple options for interactionAdded simple fighting between settlementsAdded razing - structures can be destroyed with attacks Children/TraitsSettlers can now get pregnant and have childrenAdded Traits which give settlers a variety of bonusesTraits can be inherited by children ResearchStructures are now unlocked through the Research menuResearching costs InfluenceEach structure category has its own research tree BackgroundsYou can unlock backgrounds for your settlementEach gives a powerful, settlement wide effectRecruitmentReworked RecruitmentStart with only 6 optionsMore options can be added by building Recruitment Structures Tons of UI ChangesJust lookThere are so many other things, but nothing else big enough to list here. Test out the new version and you'll see.Working Toward Full ReleaseWith this update, I've got pretty much every system I want in Settler's Domain. So much more could be added, but it's out of scope for a solo-dev (me) who actually wants to get it released. So, now what's needed is more content. More structures, resources, traits, backgrounds, whatever. That, along with bug fixes and performance improvements.I'll do my best, and will hopefully be sharing a release date within the coming months!- rick

newsitems.title: Update - Demo Build v0.2
newsitems.author: rick
newsitems.contents: Demo build v0.2 is live! This update contains a decent amount of changes, which I'll do my best to outline below. As always, feedback encouraged! There's a feedback button in the game menu which links to a Google form. Feel free to post in the community hub as well. Bug reporting is also much appreciated! {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45355702/ad0767e7465a1a4bc0315acd88ac8ab8122af970.gif Changes: Demo Format Worlds can now be played for unlimited days Season length changed from 10 to 25 days Settlers Added settler stats: Efficiency, Immunity, and Devotion. Added daily resource needs: Food, Medicine, and Influence Added conditions: Hunger, Health, and Devotion Added Diseases, which can be contracted by settlers with low Health Added the Coup event, which is started by settlers with low Devotion Removed settler Happiness Resources Added Medicine resources, which are consumed to keep settler Health high Trees now regrow Flax now regrows Some Medicine resources regrow Resource spawn rates changed Structures Added Wood Bridge Added Mushroom Cellar Added Purple Mushroom Cellar Added Jammery Removed Kitchen Gardening Shed now must be placed on existing Fertile Soil Explorer Tent area reduced; auto-packs when area clear Reworked Tavern and Town Hall Many structure build requirements changed Miscellaneous Winter now prevents many resources from growing Month length shortened to 25 days Harvest structures now highlight resources in range Added Info Hover to resources Added Info Tooltip when building

newsitems.title: Settler's Domain Playtest is Live!
newsitems.author: ricknichter11
newsitems.contents: The first iteration of testing has begun! This is an exciting time as the game has only ever been tested by a small pool of people (so there are likely many bugs). The game is in a basic state, but is playable and needs feedback as well as bug reporting. I'll be giving players access incrementally, with total numbers depending on how many sign up. Feedback is extremely important! Here is a quick Google form where I'll be collecting general feedback about the playtest: Settler's Domain Playtest General Feedback If you encounter a bug, instead please send a screenshot and/or description to this email: settlersdomaingame@gmail.com I appreciate any feedback, and thanks so much for wishlisting and participating in the playtest! {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45355702/ad0767e7465a1a4bc0315acd88ac8ab8122af970.gif
